title: A Birthday Invitation
description: Practise be, can and possessives, and write an invitation to a birthday party.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "is" with one thing: my party is on Saturday.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with can or can't.
answers: Can
exercises.explanation: Use "Can you + base verb?" to ask someone: Can you come?

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My house is in Green Street.
Is my house in Green Street?
exercises.explanation: Subject + be + in + street name: My house is in Green Street.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: Please bring your swimming costume.
exercises.explanation: Use "your" (not "you") before a noun to show it belongs to someone: your swimming costume.

exercises.prompt: Choose the best word to join the ideas.
exercises.text: We can swim ___ play games in the garden.
exercises.explanation: "And" joins two things that go together: swim and play games.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The party starts at three o'clock.
At three o'clock the party starts.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + at + time: The party starts at three o'clock.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week: on Saturday.

exercises.prompt: Write a or an.
exercises.text: We have got ___ big chocolate cake for the party.
answers: a
exercises.explanation: Use "a" before a consonant sound: a big cake.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There are ten childs at the party.
answers: There are ten children at the party.
exercises.explanation: The plural of "child" is "children", not "childs".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My mum ___ got a surprise for you.
exercises.explanation: Use "has got" with he, she and it (my mum = she): my mum has got.

exercises.prompt: Write in, on or at.
answers: in
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with months: in May.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My friends like dancing.
exercises.explanation: Like + verb-ing: my friends like dancing.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: It's my sister's birthday too.
It is my sister's birthday too.
exercises.explanation: Add 's to a person to show that something belongs to them: my sister's birthday.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There ___ games and music at the party.
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with plural nouns: there are games.

exercises.prompt: Complete with can or can't.
exercises.text: My cousin ___ come because he is on holiday.
answers: can't
cannot
can not
exercises.explanation: Use "can't" (cannot) when something is not possible: he can't come.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Please bring a umbrella if it rains.
answers: Please bring an umbrella if it rains.
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an umbrella.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We have got a big garden.
Have we got a big garden?
exercises.explanation: Subject + have got + thing: We have got a big garden.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Come and meet my cousins. ___ names are Lily and Max.
exercises.explanation: Use "their" before a noun to talk about something that belongs to them: their names.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The party finish at six o'clock.
answers: The party finishes at six o'clock.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, verbs ending in -sh take -es: it finishes.

exercises.prompt: Complete with because or but.
exercises.text: We can play in the garden ___ it is big.
answers: because
exercises.explanation: Use "because" to give a reason: we can play there because it is big.

task.prompt: Write an invitation to your birthday party.
contentPoints: Say what the party is for.
Give the day, time and place.
Say what you can do at the party.
usefulLanguage: Please tell me if you can come.
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Lily,

Please come to my birthday party! I am ten on Saturday. The party is at my house in Green Street. It starts at three o'clock. We can swim, play games and eat cake.

Please tell me if you can come.

Love,
Rosa
